identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase II Trial of LM103 in Advanced Melanoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Multicenter, Randomized, Controlled, Open-label, Phase II Trial on Autologous Tumor Infiltrating Lymphocyte Injection (LM103 TILs) for the Treatment of Advanced Melanoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A total of 92 subjects with advanced melanoma who met the inclusion criteria will be randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to the experimental group and the control group in this phase II trial. The study will be followed up until 24 months after treatment.

interventions.name: LM103 TILs Injection
interventions.description: Extract, culture and expand tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes from resected tumor tissues in vitro for the manufactur of LM103 TILs injection. After NMA-LD, the subjects received LM103 infusion and followed by IL-2 supportive treatment.

interventions.name: Dacarbazine, temozolomide, paclitaxel, carboplatin/cisplatin
interventions.description: The subjects will start treatment with a chemotherapy regimen selected by the investigators, including dacarbazine, temozolomide, paclitaxel, carboplatin/cisplatin.

primaryOutcomes.description: PFS confirmed by the Independent Review Committee (IRC) according to RECIST 1.1
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Every 6 weeks in the first 6 months after treatment and every 12 weeks from 6 months to 24 months
